attribution: No attribution required by CC0; recommended citation: Research Organization Registry (ROR), release v2.14
decision_reason: Reviewed the pinned ROR Zenodo v2.14 record and its CC0 declaration. The exact export uses an explicit field allowlist and excludes locations because ROR identifies GeoNames-derived location data as separately CC BY 4.0. Archive and payload hashes were generated in workflow run 41933051951; the JSONL payload was inspected for 144,717 valid records and its rights candidate passed the registry validator. This certifies the exact metadata export only; it is not a natural-language training corpus and does not override G-0 or admission gates.

attribution: Crossref metadata is CC0; recommended citation: Crossref.
decision_reason: Reviewed Crossref's official metadata reuse policy: bibliographic facts and Crossref-generated metadata are public domain/CC0, while abstracts remain publisher/author copyright. This exact API export excludes abstracts, descriptions and full-text/PDF/content links. API response and transformed payload hashes were generated in workflow run 41933591839; both rights candidate and exact-scope schema passed validation. This certifies metadata rights only, not dataset admission or training eligibility.

attribution: DataCite metadata is CC0; recommended citation: DataCite.
decision_reason: Reviewed DataCite's official statement that DOI metadata in its Metadata Store is CC0 and used only the unauthenticated public REST API. This exact export excludes descriptions/abstracts and all dataset payload files, full text and content links. API response and transformed payload hashes were generated in workflow run 41933591839; both rights candidate and exact-scope schema passed validation. This certifies metadata rights only, not dataset admission or training eligibility.
